facts.fact: The government launched pilot cases numériques with satellite internet in Doufiguisso and Lemnogo villages on 19 February 2026, with the FASU and UEMOA, and the current white-zone phase covers 750 zones with no mobile connectivity.
The article states that of 1,700 white zones identified, 283 were covered in 2022 and 138 in 2024.
